projects.title: swift-cli
projects.description:
Over the course of many years developing high precision gnss products and services, Swift Navigation had accumulated a growing ecosystem of internal tools and utilities for gnss protocol conversion, data analysis, cli's for internal systems, etc.

The concept of the swift-cli was to build a meta-cli that abstracted away the details of downloading, installing, and updating of these utilities behind a single convenient interface.

Over the course of several months I built out the initial feature set of swift-cli including a package registry, auth, download, install, update, and upgrades, culminating in a release of the product to the broader engineering organization.

Since it's initial release, the tool has become broadly adopted in the engineering org and has grown in terms of features and sophistication.

projects.title: JLaWS
projects.description:
The Joint Laser Weaponeering System (JLaWS) was a desktop application developed for the purpose of simulating laser weapon system effectiveness against target systems of interest such as UAV's.

The original JLaWS Phase 1 effort was well received and gained strong customer traction leading to an increase in funding and expanded scope and roadmap. My primary contribution to this program was leading a team of 4 developers in a complete re-write of the application to support this expanded scope.
